senses.gloss: नाथ् नाथ्, and नाध् नाध् (akin to नम्), i. 1, Ātm. (also Par., MBh. 3, 12630). To beg, MBh. 12, 1365 (with gen. of the object, MBh. 3, 12630).

नाथ नाथ् + अ, m.
 1. A protector, MBh. 12, 2292.
 2. A master, a lord, Pañc. v. d. 90; Rām. 1, 76, 19.
 3. A husband, Ragh. 12, 75.
 --Comp.
नाथत्व नाथ + त्व, n. The dignity of a protector, Rām. 2, 81, 2 Gorr.

नाथवन्त् नाथ + वन्त्, adj., f. वती.
 1. Having a protector, Rām. 1, 62, 12.
 2. Having a husband, 5, 37, 20.
नाथाय नाथाय, a denomin. derived from नाथ with य, Par. To grant, Bhāg. P. 2, 9, 25.
नाथिन् नाथिन्, i. e. नाथ + इन्, adj., f. नी, Having a protector, Rām. 1, 78, 3 Gorr.
